text: I have had it twice in 3 months now. You can contact their customer service and they replace them quickly. Please keep the old one to send back via the courier. Also did have this so much before

text: I am a type 2 using the 3 plus. It is a smaller sensor and when I first started using it it came off right after putting it on. I get adhesive covers and haven’t lost one since. Do contact Abbot you can call them or use FB messenger.
